value.constraints_lab_compilation: Same structure as intentions lab (scripts that pull data), but different sourcing. Intentions: mostly in code, copied to the intentions lab. Negative learnings: mostly in feedback collections of some kind, compiled to the constraints lab. Same compilation pattern, different source topology.
value.device_name: CodeMother. Mascot: Code Monkey from the song of the same name by Jonathan Coulton. Code address: cairn/devices/codemother/. Instance address: ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/. Per-project: ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/projects/<project>/.
value.device_vs_machine: DEVICE. Its own PID, launched by its shim. Not a machine inside cairn — it reasons ABOUT projects, including cairn.
value.graph_tree_access: Direct. Everybody accesses their own trees directly. The librarian keeps a master tree of top-level trees (the catalog/index), but does not mediate reads. Each device goes to its own trees.
value.multi_project: Project-agnostic device. First project is cairn itself. Each project gets its own artifact tree at ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/projects/<project>/. For cairn, CairnCommons remains the history (public research project). For other projects, the project folder IS the commons equivalent — private, in instance-space. Universal vocabulary (GOF, SOLID, architectural smells) is project-agnostic at device level.
value.process_model: Its own PID, launched by its shim in response to: (1) API calls (MCP over the bus), (2) chat calls, (3) command line calls, (4) skill steps that invoke it. Already has pieces in the prebuild step (the constrain stage territory). Not a daemon — shim-launched on demand.
